review_type: AI editorial review of eight B1 Spreken middellange taken (narrate three pictures ×2, convince after a cue, advise from a table, instruct from two pictures, compare-and-choose from a table, advise after a cue, instruct from one picture) and their sentence starters: prompt shape and speech act, cues, image briefs and tables, criteria against the prompt, sample quotes and learner errors, model coverage, length and level, originality; the 017 review's findings applied as checks; repairs applied in the proposed files
verdict_summary: All eight tasks pass in the proposed file; none rejected. Eighteen edits: fifteen in the batch, four required in afvalcontainers (criteria 1–2 narrowed to what the prompt asks, quote 1, the model) and eleven recommended (three prompts trimmed to 63/61/59 words with the werktelefoon budget moved into the table caption, two cues trimmed to 29 words, five image-brief consistency edits), and three in the starters (two required in step with the afvalcontainers criteria, one that served one course only). Domains kept as labelled (werk 3 / educatie 2 / overig 3). Level: all comparable with the official Deel 2 task descriptions; cursus-engels, afvalcontainers and werktelefoon at the fuller end, brandalarm at the lighter end; no off-level flag. The checker reports no failures and no warnings on the proposed bytes.

Counts stay 3/2/3; no relabel, no "medecursist" rewrite.
author_doubts_decisions.2_taalcafe_educatie: Educatie: the candidate is a cursist of the taalschool whose taalcafé this is; the 017 eerste-schooldag rule (an adult narrating a child's day) does not apply.
author_doubts_decisions.3_two_narration_tenses: Accepted as in 017; tense consistency belongs to the b1-spreken feedback, not to a criterion.
author_doubts_decisions.4_prompt_length: Trimmed where a fact could leave without a scored element: cursus-engels 63 words (certificate wish is in the table), afvalcontainers 61 (turn-taking unscored), werktelefoon 59 (budget moved into the table caption). No cue added; stimulus counts unchanged.
author_doubts_decisions.5_sample_lengths: Accepted (46–58 words; each shorter than its model).
author_doubts_decisions.6_cue_lengths: Trimmed to 29 and 29 words; the three weeks, the heater proposal, the first-interview fact and the nerves stay.
author_doubts_decisions.7_colour_scheme_and_pair: The colour convention is no longer scored (criterion 1 narrowed to the grey container the prompt fixes); the sample and model may still name it as a plausible addition. Pair accepted: same person, container and building; the change of place and the evening are the step asked.
author_doubts_decisions.8_sample_and_model_disagree: Accepted for cursus-engels and werktelefoon: the criteria score the argumentation, not the choice; feedback must accept either option; starters neutral (S1 makes cursus-engels starter 2 two-sided).
author_doubts_decisions.9_brandalarm_diagram: Accepted as a text-free drawn illustration (blueprint §7 keeps maps as real text because generated text is unreliable; this plan has none). Media risk noted; fallback is an SVG plan in the app, not a corridor scene.
author_doubts_decisions.10_names_across_batches: No conflict with 026–030; a 030 + 031 mock form puts no name in two roles.
author_doubts_decisions.11_invented_details_in_models: Accepted; the feedback must not require them.
author_doubts_decisions.12_near_neighbours_drills: The author's three drills are adopted; afvalcontainers and 017 glasbak never in one drill or adjacent in a form.

Gebruik alle drie de plaatjes." (47 words). Roos (young woman, dark hair in a bun, yellow scarf) verbatim in all three briefs; order tram → bakery counter → lost-property counter unambiguous; the wallet is the continuity object (now "clearly visible") and the shoulder bag runs through all three panels after edit E2. B1:speaking:batch031-cursus-engels:1.level_reason: Advice from a four-row table tied to three situation facts plus a drawback, the 017 fietskeuze shape; model 63 words with zodat, bovendien, a spelled-out price, longest sentence 20; four elements in 30 seconds is the fuller end of the official advise task.

Table 4 × 3, 34 words: price € 275 / € 495, one evening / two evenings, 20 / 10 weeks, bewijs van deelname / officieel certificaat met examen; course 1 wins on price and evenings (money, children), course 2 on certificate and duration (the job), so either side carries two table points. Model 63 words recommends course 1 and meets 1–4 ("Ik zou cursus één nemen", price and one evening, "als je weinig geld hebt", "oppas voor de kinderen", "Het nadeel is dat je alleen een bewijs van deelname krijgt"). Register je. Domain educatie (learner role, school setting, course choice).
